claims.one_line: r1 split: in-cat +2.97 / dark +15.83. Across all 10 runs the dark component is +15.83…+17.14 and ALWAYS positive; the in-cat component is small, noisy (−1.83…+2.97) and flips sign in one run — traced to a single high-leverage event, event_idx 889.

claims.title: The mechanism: impostor rejection → completion fallback
claims.status: observations FINDING; mechanism AS STATED REFUTED; replaced by an AMENDED mechanism
claims.one_line: Observed: 64.7% of dark events have an identically-zero 2D catalogue leg at h = 0.73, and survivors are suppressed by a median factor 7.8×10⁻³. But those 487 always-zero events carry +0.24 of the +15.83 nats (1.5%): 98.5% is carried by the 534 survivors.
claims.adjudication: Deletion is NOT the mechanism. The amended mechanism is DE-WEIGHTING: the dark mean catalogue mixture weight falls 0.0354 → 0.0061 at h = 0.73, the dark class’s opposition collapses −24.46 → −0.63 nats, and its argmax moves 0.640 → 0.785. Budget: +15.83 = 0 (completion, cancels exactly) + 19.10 (loss of the 1D catalogue down-tilt) − 3.27 (residual 2D tilt).
claims.refute_by: algebraic decomposition ln p = ln C + ln(1+R) — DONE; ln C cancels identically

claims.title: 58% of in-catalogue hosts rail at the prior edge
claims.one_line: Per-event 1D argmax over [0.60, 0.86], 76 in-catalogue hosts: median 0.860, 44/76 = 57.9% at the edge (idealized: 0.730, 4/76 = 5.3%). Replicates 10/10 runs at 54–67%, against a 2.4% flat-surface expectation.
claims.adjudication: Not an edge artifact: railed profiles are genuinely concave, top-K vertices give h_eff = 0.93–1.05 stable over K = 3–9, and a grid extended to h = 2.4 finds interior peaks (median ≈ 1.12) — a clipped real runaway. FAIR-FRAMING AMENDMENT (binding, both halves always): per event the rail is cosmetic (0.072–0.134 nats = 0.30–0.47 σ_event, 0–1.3% exceed 1σ), BUT the class-summed displacement is +3.4 to +6.1 σ_class in 8/10 runs.
claims.refute_by: widen the grid above 0.86 and see whether the peaks move further or stop — DONE, the refutation attempt FAILED

claims.title: The host-z numerator kernel omits selection
claims.status: promoted to FINDING (measured), with corrected law; scope narrowed
claims.one_line: bayesian_statistics.py:4201-4207 weights the host-z numerator kernel by the cosmic prior w_pop = (dV_c/dz)/(1+z), with no p_det and no catalogue selection. Measured inflation law $h_{\rm eff}/h_{\rm true} = [1+\sqrt{1+12(\sigma_z/z)^2}]/2 \to 1+3(\sigma_z/z)^2$; rail threshold σ_z/z > 0.256.
claims.adjudication: Confirmed as the mechanism for C5’s catalogue-leg per-event rail by direct measurement of the code’s own numerator. COLLIDES with the RATIFIED G2b derivation, which confirmed exactly that weight, without p_det, as uniquely consistent and exactly h-independent, protected by a binding regression gate. Any fix must EXPLICITLY SUPERSEDE G2b. The measured historical failure mode of the deconvolution at large σ_z/z was OVER-correction — the opposite sign to where a C7 fix pushes. Cell B is the staleness-free magnitude check.
claims.refute_by: compute the induced host-z shift numerically for the 76 hosts at their real σ_z — DONE, it confirmed; the collision with G2b is unresolved

claims.title: The 2D posterior is reparametrization-dependent
claims.status: promoted to FINDING (well-posedness defect); cause RELOCATED
claims.one_line: Rescaling the mass coordinate by an arbitrary constant C walks the 2D MAP: 0.81329 / 0.78107 / 0.74440 / rails at 0.600 for C = 1 / 0.3 / 0.1 / ≤ 0.01. The 1D channel is bitwise invariant across the whole sweep.
claims.adjudication: The stated cause is REFUTED: D, β_G and β_Ḡ are all mass-dimensionless, so it is not “4D numerator vs 3D D(h)”. The mismatch is BETWEEN THE TWO NUMERATOR LEGS — the 2D catalogue leg carries exactly one mass density, the completion leg carries none — and the code silently hard-wires the measure to $dM_z/M_{z,\rm det,i}$, the event’s own measured detector-frame mass (span 1.33×10⁵–1.63×10⁶ M☉, a factor 12). A consistent physical unit change M → kM is exactly invariant.
claims.refute_by: re-run the C-scaling on regenerated per-event 2D data; check the 1D invariance is exact — DONE, reproduced exactly

claims.title: w_G is mis-calibrated against the code’s own generator
claims.status: FINDING [LOCAL, VERIFIED] — live, gated on cell B
claims.one_line: Model w_G(0.73) = 0.1215037 versus the realized detected in-catalogue rate 164/3135 = 0.05231; binomial z = −11.86 pooled. Localized to β_G weighting f(z) by the pool-marginal (population-mass) p_det while Malmquist-selected catalogue hosts carry heavier M–σ masses; mass-aware w_G = 0.05149 gives z = +0.21.
claims.adjudication: Adjudicator’s discount: the “removes 84% of the bias” counterfactual must be read against C5’s leverage finding — in a near-flat profile many ±10-nat interventions move the MAP a lot. What is solid independent of leverage is the z = −11.86 generator-vs-inference inconsistency and the two-way 0.392 / 0.399 agreement. Extended to the dark side: the realized detected dark-host z-distribution is skewed high against β_Ḡ’s own coded integrand, KS D = 0.0863, p = 1.08×10⁻¹⁹. RE-LITIGATION GUARD: the exonerated w_G = β_G/D bookkeeping FIX FORM merely relocated the tilt (+94…+455 nats, 12/12 fail, ledger #61) and must not be re-tried — the DEFECT is live.
claims.refute_by: show the two estimands are in fact compatible — i.e. that the realized 164/3135 is not the quantity w_G models
